Sedona 86336, a guide for chauffeured groups

Sedona (86336) is Arizona's most iconic destination, famous for its stunning red rock formations, spiritual vortexes, world-class spas, and vibrant arts scene. Located approximately 2 hours north of Phoenix, Sedona attracts millions seeking natural beauty, outdoor adventure, and wellness experiences. Our luxury day trip transportation from Phoenix provides the perfect way to experience Sedona's magic without the stress of driving.

Neighborhood guide

Sedona is divided into distinct areas: Uptown Sedona offers galleries, restaurants, and tourist shops along the main corridor. West Sedona provides a more local feel with dining and shopping. The Village of Oak Creek features Bell Rock views and access to popular trails. Tlaquepaque Arts & Shopping Village recreates a traditional Mexican village with artisan galleries. Oak Creek Canyon to the north offers dramatic scenery and swimming holes. The town's unique energy draws spiritual seekers, artists, hikers, and those seeking rejuvenation.

Getting there from Scottsdale

About 2 hours each way from Scottsdale

The run north on the 17 and up Highway 179 takes roughly two hours in normal conditions, and longer on a spring weekend when the Highway 89A corridor through Uptown backs up. A one-way or round-trip ride north is booked on the Phoenix and Scottsdale to Sedona transfer page; a full day with the vehicle waiting at each trailhead, gallery and tasting room is the Sedona red rocks day trip.

Frequently asked questions

How long is the drive from Phoenix to Sedona?

Sedona is approximately 115 miles north of Phoenix, typically a 2-hour drive via I-17. Our luxury transportation allows you to relax and enjoy the scenic journey through Arizona's high desert without the stress of driving.

Do you offer Sedona day trips from Phoenix?

Yes! Our Sedona day trips are among our most popular services. We provide comfortable transportation, allowing you to explore red rocks, visit galleries, enjoy lunch, and experience vortexes before returning to Phoenix.

Can you arrange wine tasting transportation in Verde Valley?

Absolutely! The Verde Valley wine region near Sedona has excellent wineries. We offer wine tour transportation to tasting rooms in Jerome, Cottonwood, and Cornville, ensuring safe and enjoyable wine country experiences.

Do you provide wedding transportation in Sedona?

Sedona is a premier wedding destination with stunning backdrops. We provide elegant transportation for ceremonies, receptions, and guest shuttles at venues like L'Auberge, Enchantment Resort, and private red rock locations.
